Awsome chocolate cake (in case you need a new one now): 6 eggs, 1 tablette of cooking chocolate (250g). Melt the chocolate, mix with the yolks carefully. Beat the whites into stiff peaks and mix. No sugar, no butter, very rich and decadent (cut thin slices, two fingers' width). For my family it serves something like 20 slices
